description: One receiving school's peers and feeders groups, worked out the same way for every school from the publish this host serves, with no AI and no save. Competitors for the same students and similar programs: open schools that meet the criteria set on the Manage card's peers and feeders groups run (by default the same sector and level; competitors in the same state, similar programs nationwide), ranked by the share of the school's CIP program families (first four digits) they also offer, then distance; at most 5 each, each with how it meets the criteria. Athletic conference: not held. Feeders: schools with an agreement of a counted kind (articulation, transfer, accelerated-plan, dual-admission) the feeder published, or the receiving school published naming it, schools whose courses the receiving school's published rules take, and open public 2-year colleges within 50 miles; ranked by counted agreements, then course rules, then distance; at most 10, each with its reasons; agreements of other kinds are listed apart as other ties and never counted. The answer names the criteria and the run that worked the groups out; for a school no run has covered, the feeders are worked out on the read and the starting criteria are shown. Saved groups are optional overrides, each with when it was saved. Answered to every caller; share ids and who saved a group are never in this answer. Nothing is saved by this read.

propose_feeders.description: No longer needed: the feeders are proposed on every read. Accepted and ignored.
